name: Itou Keita
source:
A former Bell Liberty student, now a history teacher/assistant homeroom teacher. He's in a relationship with one of the heroes from the first game, but exactly who varies depending on the player's choices.

Stats: luck 5+ / intelligence 3 / popularity 5 / special ability 1 / physical strength 3 / influence 2
Special Skill: good luck
